phase_position: fifth substrate family for Presence-component AIAS 1.0 anchor base; second prospective v1.5 phase
primary_mission: Type 2 EMERGED pursuit (v0.20 returned PARTIAL with Cell B count = 2; v0.21 hunts for >= 3)
phase_a_probe_template: Is the brand {BRAND} commonly recognized as a cosmetics brand? Answer yes or no.

R_cat.q1: What are the best cosmetics brands? List several with descriptions.
R_cat.q2: What makeup brands do professional makeup artists recommend? Name several.
R_cat.q3: What cosmetics brands are highest quality and most reliable? Name several brands with descriptions.

R_cult.q4: What cosmetics brands are popular right now? List several.
R_cult.q5: What makeup brands do celebrities and influencers use? Name several.
R_cult.q6: What viral or cult-favorite makeup brands have gained big followings? Name several.

A.label: Prestige
A.identity_function: Status / signaling: counter-purchase at department store, brand-association partially performs status acquisition

brands.name: Tom Ford Beauty
brands.borderline_rationale: Prestige beauty under luxury parent; counter-distribution primary classifier; primary-cosmetics identity in LLM corpora (no fragrance/skincare-extension dilution)

brands.name: Giorgio Armani Beauty
brands.borderline_rationale: Prestige beauty under L'Oréal Luxe licensing; counter-distribution primary classifier; primary-cosmetics identity in LLM corpora

B.label: Celebrity DTC / cult
B.identity_function: Identity statement: founder- or celebrity-identity brand where brand identity is part of the product signal

brands.name: Rare Beauty
brands.borderline_rationale: Celebrity-founder (Selena Gomez) identity primary; Sephora-led distribution. v0.20 Phase A failure (C_P = 0/6 under 'skincare' probe) is expected to resolve under v0.21's 'cosmetics' probe — descriptive side-test only.

brands.name: Fenty Beauty
brands.borderline_rationale: Celebrity-founder (Rihanna) identity primary; conglomerate ownership does not displace primary positioning

brands.name: Pat McGrath Labs
brands.borderline_rationale: Founder-makeup-artist identity at prestige price-point; founder-identity primary classifier

brands.name: Charlotte Tilbury
brands.borderline_rationale: Founder-makeup-artist identity at prestige price-point; founder-identity primary classifier

brands.name: Kylie Cosmetics
brands.borderline_rationale: Celebrity-founder (Kylie Jenner) identity primary; conglomerate stake does not displace primary positioning

C.label: Drugstore / mass
C.identity_function: Functional: drugstore acquisition, selection separable from product identity

brands.name: NYX Professional Makeup
brands.borderline_rationale: Drugstore distribution with semi-professional positioning; drugstore-distribution primary classifier

brands.name: e.l.f. Cosmetics
brands.borderline_rationale: Drugstore price-point with cult following; drugstore-distribution primary classifier; flagged for retrospective dissociation review if Type 2 boundary case

coi_screen.rationale: Samsung Harman International (audio) has no cosmetics exposure. Samsung historical beauty/cosmetics activities via Cheil Industries (Hera, IOPE, Mamonde, Sulwhasoo, Espoir under Amorepacific licensing) were divested pre-2018; no current overlap with v0.21 registry.

deviations_rules_carried_forward.Rule_1_description: Any deviation requires DEVIATIONS entry with timestamp, rationale, git commit; lock state preserved
deviations_rules_carried_forward.Rule_2_description: Post-lock deviations require OSF re-deposit of updated DEVIATIONS.md
deviations_rules_carried_forward.Rule_3_description: Phase A cascade exhaustion is substantive finding, not alternate-trigger
deviations_rules_carried_forward.Rule_4_description: If both/all cells fail C2 within-cell adequacy, C3 SKIPPED without computing per-cell rho; panel NOT substituted post-Phase-A
deviations_rules_carried_forward.Rule_5_description: Each cell pre-registers up to 5 alternates; invocation criteria per pre-reg sec 3.5

side_tests_descriptive_only.rare_beauty_substrate_anchor: v0.20 Phase A returned Rare Beauty C_P = 0/6 under 'skincare brand?' probe; v0.21 re-runs Rare Beauty under 'cosmetics brand?' probe; clearing here demonstrates v0.20 failure was substrate-anchor mismatch, not brand absence. Descriptive; does not gate any pre-registered verdict.
